title: #287 Gap Year
prompt: Nowadays, many students choose to take a gap year before starting their college. What are the advantages and disadvantages of it?

promptSegments.text: Nowadays, many students choose to take a gap year before starting their college.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of it?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of a gap year is that it helps students become more independent by allowing them to experience life outside of school.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of a gap year is that it helps students become more independent by allowing them to experience life outside of school.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of a gap year is that it can cause students to forget academic knowledge, creating a knowledge gap.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage of a gap year is that it can cause students to forget academic knowledge, creating a knowledge gap.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses the positive aspect of a gap year: helping people find their true interests.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph discusses the positive aspect of a gap year: helping people find their true interests.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the negative aspect of a gap year: causing financial problems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph discusses the negative aspect of a gap year: causing financial problems.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of a gap year is that it provides time for personal growth and self-discovery, helping students gain real-life skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of a gap year is that it provides time for personal growth and self-discovery, helping students gain real-life skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of a gap year is that it can cause students to forget school knowledge, making it difficult to restart college studies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage of a gap year is that it can cause students to forget school knowledge, making it difficult to restart college studies.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of a gap year is gaining valuable life experience, which helps build important life skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of a gap year is gaining valuable life experience, which helps build important life skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of a gap year is the risk of losing academic focus, making it hard to adjust to university studies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage of a gap year is the risk of losing academic focus, making it hard to adjust to university studies.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list advantages and disadvantages without making the required judgement.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên đưa ra nhận định bắt buộc.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
